answer: Ghost keys cannot share a living bed. An applicant stakes 3.15 POA, tends one 4 m² plot in a 36-bed rooftop garden for 11 days, and takes a 9-minute berth at a one-gate harbor. They deliver 38 g of nectar with a plot-unique pollen microtag through a lock timed from the epoch seed and pubkey. A 200-clone farm needs 200 exclusive beds and berths in that tide window, plus 630 POA. Graders weigh the jar to 0.2 g, match the microtag to the bed ledger, and replay lock time from the seed. A pour under 36 g, a reused berth, or a miss over 4 minutes slashes 48% and benches the dock for two epochs.
